summary: Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated October 8, 2026 for a public offering of 2,000,000 shares of its 9.25% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at $25.00 per share, plus a 30-day option for 300,000 additional shares. Stifel Nicolaus is representative of the underwriters. Expected net proceeds are approximately $48.4 million before expenses, with closing expected on or about October 19, 2026. This is a routine preferred equity shelf takedown under the February 2025 Form S-3, not a special situation; the structural notes are the preferred liquidation preference and dividend rate, with watch items limited to pricing, over-allotment exercise and use of proceeds.
